Hi Chris / Aparna,

Looking forward to the walkthrough on Wednesday, Jun 28 at 11:00 AM PT. Attached is a short agenda (15–20 min demo, 10 min Q&A). Plan is to cover:

Thanks Jonas — quick heads up from our side. Our SE who would be joining (internal rotation) was just moved to on-call that week, so they’ll likely be interrupted. That makes a live technical deep-dive risky (we may have to drop mid-call).

Two asks:
1) Is there a way to convert the session to a short recorded walkthrough we can watch asynchronously, and then follow up with a 30-min live Q&A with whoever is available?
2) If we do record, can you include a brief timestamped notes file (or timestamps in the recording) so we can jump to config/ops sections?

We’re still very interested — just want to avoid dropping in the middle of a live demo.

—Aparna

Appreciate the heads up, Aparna — totally understand. We can do the recording + async Q&A approach and still keep momentum. Proposed plan:

1) I’ll record a concise 25-minute walkthrough that follows the attached agenda and include timestamps in the description (Operations/config, Routing, Cost controls, Rollouts). I’ll drop the MP4 to the shared Drive by EOD Tue (June 27).

2) We’ll add a short time-stamped notes file and a one-page config checklist. (attachments: redwood-short-walkthrough.mp4 (recording stub) + timestamps.txt)

3) Schedule a live 30-min follow-up next week for any live questions/POC next steps — Marissa can lead the pricing/contract discussion, and Karthik or I will cover the technical Qs. Availability options:
   - Fri Jul 2, 09:00–09:30 PT
   - Mon Jul 5, 11:00–11:30 PT

If either of those windows work for your team, we’ll lock one in and I’ll send a calendar invite. If you prefer a different time, send two preferred slots and we’ll accommodate.

Also looping Naomi from Ops in case we need a pre-recorded demo that shows Dedicated capacity behavior under burst load (she can add a short clip).
